✨ What's New in Release v2.1.83:
- ⚡ 0ms Zero-Lag Drive Rendering: instantaneous Room DB Flow data loading without network blocking

- 🗑️ Permanent Cloud Trash Sync: soft-deletes synced with cloud backend API
- ✨ Auto-Hiding FAB: Floating Action Button hides during multi-selection to prevent overlaps
